rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved continuing education providers (certificates must show provider approval status); academic courses relevant to social work (1 credit = 20 contact hours); presenting for an approved provider; authoring/editing published work
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal after initial licensure is exempt from CE.

topics.who: In person or live interactive webinar
LGBTQ cultural competency (separate from public health priority hours)
10% of required CE in DC Health public health priority topics

rules.notes: 28 of 40 hours, incl. ethics, must be in person or live interactive webinar; upload proof with renewal. Moving to birth-month expiry (renewal in odd/even years matching birth year); transition: 50% CE accepted if under 2 years on the term, LGBTQ and public health hours still due.
